{{Top|leg}}
The '''"Invisible & Ineluctable Casino"''' was what flamboyant [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Drawmas Sma'Da]] termed his operation that covered wagers on the various battles and conflicts during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sma'Da would make odds, accept bets on either side of the outcome, then pay off and collect whenever that particular event was over. It was seen as a shadow of the actual war. No matter the outcome&mdash; either in terms of wagers or conflicts &mdash;Sma'Da seemed to come out ahead.

It was due to Sma'Da's clever wagering and seemingly impossible luck that brought him to the attention of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
